# Juan Cortés Paredes · Data Analyst

> Data Analyst based in Valladolid, Spain. 4+ years analysing business data (KPIs, reporting, dashboards, A/B testing) and a Data Analytics bootcamp (NEOLAND, 2026). Works with SQL, Python, Power BI and machine learning. Available immediately for remote roles or hybrid roles in Madrid. Spanish (native) and English (C1).

This site is Juan's portfolio, in Spanish (default) and English.

## Case studies
- [Do tourist flats push up rents in Madrid?](https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/madrid/en/): 100 neighbourhoods, 5 public sources, OLS regression (R² 0.70), K-means and a Power BI dashboard. Tourist flats have a significant but small effect (at most ≈€31/month); location and income matter most. Spanish version: https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/madrid/
- [Bargain or rip-off? Fair-price calculator for used cars](https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/coches/en/): CatBoost model trained on 71,220 AutoScout24 listings; average error €2,118 (8.5%), 33% lower than comparing with cars of the same model and age. Live app: https://chollo-o-timo-coches.streamlit.app. Spanish version: https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/coches/
- [VERSUS: −37% cost per acquisition on Google Ads](https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/versus/en/): sports betting and casino brand in Spain (Orenes Grupo). Search term, campaign structure and website funnel analysis; CPA −37%, CPL −29%, FTDs +14%, sign-ups +9% vs 2024. Spanish version: https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/versus/
- [WINNDER: from negative ROAS to break-even with social ads](https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/winnder/en/): video game competition platform in Spain (Orenes Grupo). UGC creative testing on TikTok and Meta Ads, brand campaigns on Performance Max; sign-ups +44%, FTDs +23%, ROAS from losses to break-even. Spanish version: https://juancortesp.github.io/proyectos/winnder/
